reviews.note: The Asian channels commission being executed, three weeks after it was given.
Someone else's dated rapture expectation, reported without endorsement. Worth keeping as the ambient September expectation he was working against.
This is the origin of the whole reprieve structure: the tribulation was due to start and was deferred. Everything filed under reprieve-four-years and october-grace-window traces back here.
He volunteers a limit on his own sight: others say they see past four years, he has only seen four.
Extends the window to the 6 January certification as well as the inauguration.
Adds vans, five days after the New Orleans vehicle attack.
The outpouring placed inside the four year window rather than after it.

The most important passage in this batch. An attack he had warned about happened, and he does not claim it: he says they failed. That is the opposite of the october-nothing-burger-defence move and should count when the record is scored.
Earliest catcher's mitt telling, from the 26 December 2024 visitation, five weeks before the bigger net word.
The open door doctrine applied to Las Vegas after the fact, explaining why an attack landed there.
Specific and contrarian: he names the northern border rather than the southern.
Unusually falsifiable for a rapture claim, because it names a specific household and a lifetime.
The four year window given a content: not just reprieve but a shaking and a split inside the church, with the harvest as its point.
The catchers are missing, which is the failure mode the bigger net word later addresses.
He half concedes the genre here: he does not want to use Christian lingo the way people said 2024 we will soar, but says the Lord did say it.
